The National Museum of Australia's Aboriginal-led [Songlines: Tracking the Seven Sisters](https://www.nma.gov.au/exhibitions/songlines?utm_source=chatgpt.com) project is an excellent authoritative starting point.

The sisters' journeys connect landforms, waterholes, stars, ancestry, law and survival. The public material is substantial, but cultural permission remains important: not every ceremonial detail is available for unrestricted reproduction.
